Stuffed Peppers | Instant Pot Recipes
By: A Kitchen Advisor
Published: Thursday, May 2, 2019 - 7:37am

Ingredients




1 1/2 lb ground beef
1 1/2 lb ground pork
3 lb tomatoes
1 cup cooked rice
1 carrot
2 tbsp sunflower oil
1 onion
12 bell peppers
5 cloves garlic
2 bay leaves
1/4 tsp black pepper
salt to taste

Preparation

1 Wash tomatoes and cut them into halves, then place them into the Inner Pot. 2 Pour a cup of water.Season with salt and black pepper. 2 bay leaves will bring extra flavor to your meal. 3 Close the lid and turn the steam release handle to “Sealing” position.Select (Pressure Cook) program. “High” pressure mode is a default setting. Set time to 1 minute. 4 When time is up, make a quick release. When the lid comes off, remove bay leaves and blend tomatoes. Set the tomato juice aside. 5 Select (Sauté) program and pour sunflower oil into the inner pot. 6 Cut a carrot and an onion into cubes and sauté them for about 6 minutes. 7 Cancel (Sauté) program. 8 Mix 1 1/2 lb ground beef and 1 1/2 lb ground pork in the large bowl. 9 Add 1 cup of cooked rice and 5 cloves of minced garlic. 10 Now it's time to add seared carrot and onion. Season with salt and black pepper to your taste. Mix it thoroughly. 11 Add approximately 1/4 of homemade tomato juice. Mix it well. 12 Remove and discard the tops, seeds, and membranes of the bell peppers. Spoon an equal amount of the mixture into each hollowed pepper.Place 12 stuffed bell peppers into the inner pot and pour the remaining tomato juice over the top. 13 Close the lid and turn the steam release handle to “Sealing” position.Select (Pressure Cook) program, chose “High” pressure mode. Set time to 8 minutes. 14 When time is up, make a quick release.Colorful and tasty Stuffed Peppers are ready. You may serve it with sour cream and sprinkle with dill. It will bring extra creaminess and flavor.

Stuffed Bell Peppers is one of our favorite recipes. It is our first experiment with making Stuffed Peppers in Instant Pot. Juicy and delicious main course meal will surprise you with color and taste. Another pleasant surprise: you won't spent half a day cooking this kitchen masterpiece thanks to increased speed of Pressure Cooker. Also you will save time on making dishes as pretty much all processes could be done in just one place - Instant Pot.
Both vegetable lovers and meat addicts will enjoy Stuffed Peppers.
As you know, the best recipes for busy families is the motto of our website. Be creative and don't have any fear. Experiment and have fun with transforming ordinary recipes to fast and yummy meals in Pressure Cooker. Instant Pot Recipes will make your life in the kitchen much more enjoyable.

Make your choice based on the budget, number of family members, kitchen size and other relevant considerations.
Here is a quick tip to consider when selecting the size of Instant Pot:
3Qt size - good for 2 people
	6Qt size - good for 3-4 people
	8Qt size - good for 5-6 people
